name: Split Pilot
description: Pair two tabs in a split view and send every link from the left tab into the right one, so the right stays a single stable page an agent can drive.
_comment_minimum: 111 is where content_scripts.world MAIN arrived, which is the oldest Chrome this code runs on. The split view itself needs 155 and is detected at runtime; below that the pair still routes links as ordinary neighbouring tabs.
_comment_externally_connectable: The control surface. A page served from one of these origins can pair, unpair, route a URL, and ask where the stage is — which is how an agent drives the arrangement, since neither the popup nor any chrome-extension:// page can be automated. Narrow this to the app you drive from.
